name: EMA Partners India Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2003, EMA Partners India Limited is an executive search firm offering specialized hiring solutions.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Model[1]
EMA Partners India Limited is an executive search firm specializing in leadership hiring solutions across multiple sectors. The business is supported by its subsidiaries operating in different geographies and serving distinct market segments.
Services Offered[2]
1. C-Suite and Board-Level Hiring: Through "EMA Partners" for India, the Middle East, and Singapore.
2. Mid to Senior-Level Hiring: Via "James Douglas Professional Search" in India and the Middle East.
3. Entry to Mid-Level Hiring: Using the "MyRCloud" AI-powered recruitment platform.
4. Consultancy: Leadership and HR consulting services through inactive subsidiaries (reassessing market opportunities).

pros: Debtor days have improved from 86.3 to 65.0 days.
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Earnings include an other income of Rs.6.74 Cr.
